long_biography.plain_text:
Oleg Boyko seeks financial businesses that can reach customers poorly served by conventional banks. At Finstar, his investment approach combines capital with advice on technology and expansion into developing markets. He has favoured a concentrated portfolio, allowing the group to work closely with individual companies. Its research arm has developed data platforms for mobile financial services and lending.

Boyko also established the PARASPORT Foundation during the Turin Winter Paralympics in 2006. The foundation funds national teams and individual athletes, with work extending beyond competition to rehabilitation and social integration. Its programmes expanded into Asia on its tenth anniversary, broadening the countries in which it assists Para athletes.
